subject: QBR prep: roadmap compression, near-term launch timelines & hazard register
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmecorp.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR prep: roadmap compression, near-term launch timelines & hazard register

Team —

Putting this thread together ahead of next week’s QBR sync. Product and Eng leadership asked for a concise view on the parts of the roadmap that have been compressed into the next 60 days and the primary delivery hazards we should call out to execs. I attached a first-cut hazard register (hazard_register_v1.xlsx) and an initial timeline sketch.

What I need:
- Internal owners to review the hazard register and add mitigations + likelihood estimates by EOD Monday (6/28).
- Marissa: please confirm which items on the Gantt are earliest candidates for reprioritization.
- Vivek/Monica/Karthik: short (1-paragraph) impact statement for QBR slide deck — what happens if the risk materializes and what our fallback is.

High-level notes from my review:
- Model quantization rollout (quant-v2) still shows a 2-week variance on perf regression testing; that affects latency SLOs for the hosted API.
- Dedicated infra autoscaler tests flagged a memory spill on 1 of 3 backfill scenarios; needs immediate root-cause.
- Two launches (Embeddings v4 and Streaming-enabled Chat) are adjacent in the same week; consider staggering to reduce cross-dependency risk.

Attachments: hazard_register_v1.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks — I’ll collate updates into an exec one-pager and a Drive folder for the QBR pack.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Director, Product Operations | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmecorp.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: roadmap compression, near-term launch timelines & hazard register

Thanks Naomi — good start. A few quick thoughts:

1) Executive summaries should be explicit about customer impact and mitigation cost. For example: quant-v2 regression — if not remediated, estimate a 15% latency increase for long-tail requests, incremental infra spend ~ $18k/mo, and potential SLA credits exposure for Tier 1 customers.

2) Consider two scenarios for the pack:
- Conservative: assume 2-week slip and show canary + fallback to quant-v1 (low customer-facing risk).
- Adverse: regression persists; propose temporary throttling + routing to Dedicated capacity for high-traffic keys.

3) Infra autoscaler memory spill: please include the failing test ID and the backfill job manifest in the hazard register so SREs can reproduce.

If useful I can draft the impact bullets for the exec slide — tag me for the items you want me to own.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Engineering | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmecorp.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 09:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: roadmap compression, near-term launch timelines & hazard register

Looping in an updated timeline: attached roadmap_gantt_v3.pdf. Key calls I made are inline in the comments section but summary here:

- Move Embeddings v4 from July 12 -> July 26 to give quant-v2 testing an additional stabilization window. That defers some smaller infra config changes by one sprint.
- Streaming-enabled Chat remains on July 19 but with a reduced feature set (disable third-party tool-calls at launch).
- We can defer the multi-tenant metrics export feature to September without customer impact.

Open asks:
- Naomi: can you confirm if Acme (Samantha) is okay with the Embeddings shift? They are currently in the early adopter cohort for v4.
- Karthik: need a one-line call on whether the reduced feature set for Chat is acceptable for go/no-go criteria.

Attachment: roadmap_gantt_v3.pdf

—Marissa
Senior PM, Product Delivery

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmecorp.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: roadmap compression, near-term launch timelines & hazard register

Thanks Naomi/Marissa — Acme readout: we prefer the Embeddings v4 delay (July 26) to avoid our planned audit window (7/13–7/16). The audit coincides with our heavy indexing job and we don’t want to introduce risk.

On Streaming Chat: the reduced feature set is acceptable for initial rollout as long as the SDK surface and latency targets are kept. Please surface any known feature gaps we should plan for in our integration checklist.

Samantha
Head of Platform Partnerships, Acme Corp
Samantha.Lee@acmecorp.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>

Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: roadmap compression, near-term launch timelines & hazard register

Thanks everyone — consolidating next steps below and scheduling a 30m sync to finalize the QBR slide bullets. Meeting link: https://meet.google.com/xxx-xxxx-xxx. Drive folder with artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBR-Prep-NAOMI-ROADMAP

Action items (owners + due dates):
- All: update hazard_register_v1.xlsx with mitigation owner, estimated impact, and test IDs by EOD Mon 6/28 — OWNER: All.
- Marissa: finalize final Gantt and mark any deferred features as "deferred" in the doc — DUE: Mon 6/28. Attachment: roadmap_gantt_v3.pdf
- Vivek: prepare two executive-impact bullets for quant-v2 (conservative vs adverse) — DUE: Mon 6/28.
- Karthik: confirm acceptability of reduced feature set for Streaming Chat in one-line reply — DUE: EOD Sun 6/27.
- Monica: prioritize SRE runbook entries for autoscaler backfill scenario and attach failing job manifest to the hazard register — DUE: Tue 6/29.

I attached the hazard register and an exec one-pager stub (exec-one-pager.docx) into Drive and the thread for reference. If there are any blocking disagreements on dates, raise them now so we can surface in the QBR. Otherwise I’ll produce the 1-page executive summary and circulate the QBR slide draft by Tue morning.

Best —
Naomi
Director, Product Operations | Redwood Inference
